brief:
You are preparing the project at /Users/alexwaldmann/Desktop/rui for autonomous work. Before SARA starts dispatching worklist items to you and others, verify and document:

1. **Environment**: The project builds and runs cleanly in isolation. Check PATH, credentials (.env if needed), system dependencies, installed packages.
2. **Credentials & Secrets**: Any API keys, GitHub tokens, or credentials needed are in place and working. Verify with a quick test if possible.
3. **Build System**: The build (npm install, cargo build, poetry install, etc.) completes without errors. Document the build command.
4. **Test Suite**: Run the existing test suite if one exists. Fix any pre-existing failures (they block detection of new breakage).
5. **Development Setup**: Editor config, linters, formatters, git hooks all working. Commit setup changes if any were needed.
6. **Documentation**: index.dx or README clearly states:
   - How to build and test this project
   - Where to find the actual code entry points
   - What the main moving parts are
   - Any project-specific rules or conventions

Do not implement features or fix bugs — setup is verification only. If something is broken or unclear, fix it enough that the next worker gets a clean slate. Commit your work (or note what you could not fix). When done, say "Setup complete" to mark this project ready.

plan.title: Establish pre-commit git hook for format enforcement
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that verifies `.git/hooks/pre-commit` exists and is executable. Implement by writing a bash pre-commit hook that runs `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` before allowing commits. Refactor by documenting the hook contract in `.helpers/hooks.md`.
plan.acceptance: `bash /Users/alexwaldmann/Desktop/rui/.git/hooks/pre-commit` succeeds with exit code 0 when code is formatted and lints pass.

plan.title: Verify Rust toolchain and dependencies availability
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that checks `rustc --version` and `cargo --version` are callable and meet minimum requirements (1.85+). Implement by adding version checks. Refactor by documenting required Rust version in CLAUDE.md.

plan.title: Test build from clean state
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that runs `rm -rf target && cargo build --all-targets`. Implement the build step. Refactor by caching build artifacts between test runs.
plan.acceptance: `cargo build --all-targets` completes with 0 exit code in under 60 seconds on an empty target directory.

plan.title: Verify all library and integration tests pass
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that runs `cargo test --all-targets --lib` and `cargo test --test '*'`. Implement by executing the test commands. Refactor by capturing and displaying test output on failure.
plan.acceptance: `cargo test --all-targets` exits with 0 and shows "test result: ok" with all tests passing.

plan.title: Verify documentation builds without warnings
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that runs `cargo doc --no-deps` with `RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings`. Implement by setting the env var and building docs. Refactor by suppressing benign doc warnings.

plan.title: Verify examples compile and identify entry points
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that enumerates `examples/*.rs` files and verifies each compiles. Implement by running `cargo build --examples` and checking each binary exists in target/debug/examples/. Refactor by documenting each example's purpose in a comment block in index.dx.
plan.acceptance: `cargo build --examples` exits with 0 and `ls target/debug/examples/ | grep -E '^(counter|controls|gallery)$'` lists all three binaries.

plan.title: Document project structure and entry points in index.dx
plan.body: Modify `index.dx` to list the main modules (`element`, `shell`, `paint`, `canvas`), their responsibilities, and the location of the library entry point (`src/lib.rs`). Verify by running `dx_read index.dx` that all sections render correctly. Refactor by ensuring the document cross-links to README.md.
plan.acceptance: `cat index.dx` shows a dx1 header and `dx read index.dx` displays the structure without errors.

plan.title: End-to-end local verification: build, test, lint, format
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that runs the full quality pipeline: `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --all-targets && cargo build --examples`. Implement as a single assertion that all four commands exit with 0. Refactor by parallelizing independent checks where possible.
plan.acceptance: Running `cargo test --test setup --lib` passes and reports the pipeline succeeded.

plan.title: Verify Cargo.toml is release-ready and document build/test commands
plan.body: Review `Cargo.toml` for correct version, description, repository, and license fields. Add a section to CLAUDE.md listing exact commands: `cargo build`, `cargo test`, `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy`. Implement by reading and validating Cargo.toml fields. Refactor by auto-generating a build checklist in `.engine/build-checklist.txt`.
plan.acceptance: `cargo metadata --format-version 1 | jq '.packages[0] | {name, version, description}' | grep -q '"rui"'` shows v0.1.0 with a description.

plan.title: Publish to crates.io and record live artifact URL
plan.body: Add a test in `tests/setup.rs` that verifies `cargo publish --dry-run` succeeds (no actual upload). Implement by running the dry-run publish. After all tests pass, execute `cargo publish` to publish v0.1.0 to crates.io. Refactor by writing the public crates.io URL to `.engine/live-url.txt` in the format `https://crates.io/crates/rui/0.1.0`.
plan.acceptance: `curl -sf https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/rui/0.1.0 | jq '.crate.name'` returns "rui" and `.engine/live-url.txt` contains the URL.
